annotations.title: Summarize text API: short summary and key points from any text

description: Summarize text with an LLM: send up to 12,000 characters and get a short summary plus bullet key points. Use for long emails, articles, transcripts, meeting notes and tool outputs; for a web page by URL use /summarize. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
